definition: Tilly Norwood is a character created using generative artificial intelligence in 2025 by Xicoia, the AI division of Particle6 Group, a production company founded by Eline Van der Velden.
details: "AI Commissioner", the first project to feature the Norwood character, was criticized by reviewers for The Guardian, PC Gamer, and The A.V. Club. A press release that talent agencies expressed interest in representing the character attracted strong criticism from Hollywood actors and firms, prompting allegations of personality rights violations and arguments over the impact of the character on production costs in the media industry.

explainer.lead: Tilly Norwood is an AI-generated character unveiled in 2025 by Xicoia, the AI division of production company Particle6 Group. Its announcement and the suggestion that talent agencies might represent it triggered a Hollywood backlash over personality rights and production costs.

tiers.eli5: Imagine a made-up actor who doesn't exist as a real person, created entirely by a computer. When the company behind it suggested real talent agencies might sign it up like a normal actor, lots of real actors got upset.
tiers.practitioner: Studios and producers weigh AI characters like Norwood against cost savings and legal risk; the pitfall is that marketing the character as a representable 'talent' invites personality-rights and labour disputes before any production work begins.
tiers.paperLevel: Not a formal method but a 2025 media artefact: a generative-AI character created by Xicoia (Particle6 Group, founded by Eline Van der Velden), first featured in the project 'AI Commissioner'. Its reception illustrates unresolved limits in personality-rights law and cost-impact arguments for AI in media production.

explainer.example: Reviewers at The Guardian, PC Gamer and The A.V. Club criticised 'AI Commissioner', and a press release claiming talent-agency interest drew strong condemnation from Hollywood actors and firms.
